classification_semantics.supported-required: Required target category with an identified native route. This is not an implemented-feature or successful-wire-test claim.
classification_semantics.rejected-by-contract: Required negative category. Rejection phase is explicit; dynamic dispatch failures are not YAML parsing failures.
classification_semantics.required-but-peer-unproven: Target remains required; do not allow stage sign-off before native compatibility/topology proof. A BLOCKED delivery gate is not an executed test result.

selection_semantics: Apply contract rejection rules first. Each category expands only its stated legal modes. Unknown categories remain separate obligations; broad categories do not promote an unknown combination.

strictly_required: strongly coupled security, download inheritance and auto branches
common_expansion.pairwise_policy: Only independent tuning parameters after each field's boundary/default tests; never a substitute for the categories above.
common_expansion.lifecycle: Each consumer protocol additionally requires cancellation, 20 lifecycle cycles, group snapshot, failure closure and current-session ownership.
common_expansion.reporting: Source inspection is provenance only. Concrete case IDs, commands, native binary identity, observations and cleanup are added by later harness work; no inferred PASS.

combinations.required_observation: TLS authentication and native Trojan TCP/UDP framing; wrong password delivers zero target bytes.
Ordinary WS plus no early data/default Sec-WebSocket-Protocol early data; verify exact first-byte ordering.
Native gRPC service framing, wrong service and stream cancellation.
Custom-header and path-suffix early data are separate native V2Ray cases; not HTTPUpgrade.
Each network/security/codec path independently transfers data; packetaddr resolves domains through the controlled resolver.
Expand auto/AES-GCM/ChaCha with padding/length 00/01/10/11. none/zero retains AEAD identity/response authentication, without padding/length.
Native network=tcp + tcpSettings.header.type=http; verify method/path/Host and byte stream after the first header.
Native network=http + httpSettings; HTTP/2 PUT body, not gRPC; cleartext prior knowledge and TLS h2.
Custom-header/path ED first proves transport with explicit raw UDP; this does not prove either extended codec.
V2Ray mux only parses targets on New; Keep does not consume per-datagram target changes. Prove exact VCore frame/address behavior rather than treating CommandMux as XUDP compatibility.
combinations.blocked_on: N0-F: multi-destination and response-address wire proof

combinations.required_observation: V2Ray has native magic-destination interception. Prove packet/stream variant, address types, framing and return path using the released binary; source presence is not a wire PASS.
Empty flow; keep omitted packet-encoding=xudp. raw is explicit none; packet is a packetaddr alias.
Empty flow and one security wrapper; native listener authentication and wrong-key negatives, not TLS skip verification.
Prove actual Vision direct mode for inner TLS1.3 and safe non-splice behavior for non-TLS/TLS1.2; only XUDP for business UDP.
Independent REALITY + Vision public-interface/direct-mode proof; ordinary padding-only success is insufficient.
Normal/fast-open and default-header ED; upgrade rejection cannot be reported as a successful stream.
UA/PING plus both scheduler branches, cancellation, bounded waiters and identity-isolated pools.
Native TCP header.type=http; no-flow transport and separate UDP codecs.
Xray source has no identified packetaddr magic-destination handler. V2Ray interception is a candidate but must prove VLESS inbound-to-native-UDP dispatch without silently changing the codec.
combinations.blocked_on: N0-F: native packetaddr decoder plus HTTP transport

combinations.required_observation: Explicit packet-encoding=none; native V2Ray legacy H2 only, never a claim that default XUDP works.
Extended standard WS ED with explicit raw codec; first-byte order and authentication retained.
Prove New/Keep framing, target changes and reply addresses against V2Ray. Default XUDP is never silently replaced with raw.
Native interception exists but requires released VLESS + transport + packetaddr data evidence, not VMess evidence.
combinations.blocked_on: N0-F: released native VLESS packetaddr proof

combinations.required_observation: Separate SNI/verification name, mTLS identities, pin/skip precedence and cache isolation; no permissive negative cases.
Expand auto/packet-up/stream-up/stream-one only with legal fields; prove resolved mode and same-handler sessions.
Every legal padding/session/seq/data placement, method, table/length, chunk/post budget and pacing branch needs a specific assertion.
Same real handler session table; aliases/ports/SAN and identity variation only when supported by that handler. Omission, false, empty and whole-object replacement are distinct.
constraints: Both legs use compatible security of the one handler.

combinations.required_observation: Main/download pool identity, omission versus empty manager, acquisition counters and retirement without killing active requests. Nondefault keepalive is H2 only.
Native H3 listener, explicit h3 with no H2 fallback, protected upstream datagrams, per-mode data/keepalive proof.
Compare each XHTTP field/value with actual latest Xray H3 request consumption; a basic H3 handshake cannot discharge all leaf-field obligations.
Native H3 dual legs must demonstrably reach one handler; distinguish TLS identity/pool overrides from independent native listeners.
combinations.blocked_on: N0-F: actual shared H3 session topology

combinations.required_observation: No packetaddr decoder has been identified in the researched Xray source. Require an official peer topology decoding both H3 and packetaddr; no default-codec substitution or custom server.
Only promote a concrete combination after an official native topology shares a session table. Two independent listeners or a transport relay do not create shared decoder state.
Expand h2mux/smux/yamux and padding on/off; only-tcp=false sends business UDP via mux, true preserves the selected VLESS codec. No Vision.
Do not equate native CommandMux/XUDP with sing-mux. Prove an official native decoder for the transport plus each sing-mux variant and only-tcp branch.
Three appearances native/xorpub/random × 1rtt/0rtt; full key/padding chains, tickets, rejection and replay cases.
A separate Vision direct-mode proof over the protocol encryption layer is required; do not infer it from TLS/REALITY.
Enumerate only concrete legal single-wrapper compositions; every native-only transport/codec gap remains unresolved rather than generating arbitrary Cartesian products.
combinations.blocked_on: N0-E/N0-F: exact outer-security and codec compatibility

combinations.required_observation: A captured/observed genuine hybrid key share is required; classic REALITY evidence does not count and explicit hybrid demand fails closed.
Static explicit ECHConfigList, actual ECH accepted on both backends, fail-closed refusal without identity/business leakage, independent download config; no DNS, retry or TLS resumption.
User/password pairing, real record authentication, ticket/cache identity and cancellation.

Selected N7 set: static ECH and Encryption on official Xray H3 or native HTTP/H2/extended WS transports. JLS retains only its already accepted Mihomo transport set; no implicit expansion to unproved wrappers.
combinations.blocked_on: N7.5: explicit native transport compositions in protocol_n7_catalog.py

combinations.required_observation: Whole-object inheritance/replacement/clear and same-handler wire proof for each retained security family; H3 standard TLS with optional static ECH only. Concrete selected pairs are frozen in protocol_n7_catalog.py; do not infer arbitrary cross-security gateways.
Authentication, multiplexed TCP streams, DATAGRAM fragmentation and mTLS; actual fixed/auto controller branches and limits.
Dual-side enabled/disabled, mismatched obfs and wrong obfs key; authenticate separately from traffic password.
Fixed 5s/random 5-7s × outer IPv4/IPv6 × obfs on/off; at least 60s, 8 ticks, at least 2 distinct ports from a 3-port fixture; one authenticated QUIC connection, not identical CID bytes.
constraints: Isolated server-only firewall changes; no host firewall modifications.
Every new client physical socket uses Dialer protection and initial group selection snapshot.

combinations.required_observation: Native disableUDP=true authentication: TCP succeeds and business UDP fails explicitly; local udp=false is a separate case.
All 7×7 ordered two-hop protocol pairs including existing SOCKS5/AnyTLS/SS2022, using distinct nodes. Expand positive and minimum-budget/capability negatives; independent DIRECT/REJECT/select cases.

combinations.when: Vision with WS, HTTPUpgrade, gRPC, HTTP camouflage, legacy H2, XHTTP or sing-mux.
combinations.required_observation: Reject before creating resources; do not silently remove flow.

combinations.when: Vision with raw or packetaddr UDP encoding.
combinations.required_observation: Only XUDP is allowed.

combinations.when: Attempt to disable mandatory TLS or provide an unsupported tls switch.
combinations.required_observation: Strict schema; no cleartext Trojan path.

combinations.when: Two or more ordinary certificate TLS, REALITY or JLS security modes on the same leg; ECH is ordinary TLS only and conflicts with REALITY/JLS/Vision. Includes conflicting inherited download objects.
combinations.required_observation: Reject rather than choosing one or clearing an inherited object implicitly.
Bind these options only to certificate TLS.

combinations.when: XHTTP H3 with cleartext, REALITY or JLS on that leg.
combinations.required_observation: H3 requires standard TLS1.3; no H3-to-TCP fallback.
Configuration error; do not ignore the download leg.

combinations.when: Explicit positive max-connections and positive max-streams together.
combinations.required_observation: Reject shadowed scheduling settings rather than accepting ineffective input.

combinations.when: Explicit positive smux.max-connections and positive smux.max-streams together.
combinations.required_observation: Reject shadowed scheduling settings.

combinations.when: cipher none/zero with global-padding=true or authenticated-length=true; or alterId != 0.
combinations.required_observation: No ignored flags and no legacy identity fallback.

combinations.when: HTTPUpgrade with custom-header/path ED, or fast-open without HTTPUpgrade.
combinations.required_observation: Only the declared default-header ED mode is in the HTTPUpgrade contract.

combinations.when: Path-suffix early data with a query in the configured WS path.
combinations.required_observation: Ambiguous path construction is rejected.

combinations.when: ws/grpc/http/h2 option objects on a different network, or ineffective TLS-only options with tls=false.
combinations.required_observation: Do not parse and ignore a field.

combinations.when: Packet-up with no-grpc-header=true; stream modes with seq overrides; body uplink with chunk/key overrides; H1 with nondefault keepalive; false obfs with tokenish; ambiguous placement keys.
combinations.required_observation: Strict conditional validation; all individual cases are expanded from the field contracts.

combinations.when: Business UDP requested when local udp=false.
combinations.required_observation: Deny business UDP but keep required outer HY2/H3 UDP transport for TCP; no alternate route.

combinations.when: Selected upstream lacks datagram support or effective payload budget is below QUIC requirements.
combinations.required_observation: Fail under the shared establishment deadline; never open a bypass socket.

combinations.when: hop-interval without ports, interval below 5s, inverted range, zero or unrepresentable timer.
combinations.required_observation: Reject instead of Mihomo-style clamping.
